body:
### 🇨🇳 中文更新日志
* 🐳 **首发自托管智能相册**：支持一键部署后端与 SSH 隧道，提供 Pinch 网格缩放、大图视差滑屏、苹果级 Hero 飞入及 PC 键盘/滚轮翻页。
* ⚡ **极致优化相册性能**：重构后端预览缓存免去 CPU 阻塞；客户端引入局部渲染与跳转节流，高刷屏快速滑动 120Hz 极致贴手流畅。
* 🖥️ **重塑仪表盘为超跑/苹果运动圆环**：CPU 与内存监控重绘为发光表盘与运动圆环，对齐 API 真实遥测；顶部新增一键深色模式切换。
* 📂 **SFTP 大文件断点续传**：传输引擎支持上传与下载的原地暂停、继续及断网后断点续传，全面提升大文件管理稳定性。
* 🐚 **终端组件深度集成**：取消底栏独立 Tab 并改为仪表盘快捷小卡片；主页精简底部 GPU 图表；全量适配手机端灵动岛/刘海屏安全区。
* 🔒 **高级功能 PRO 授权锁**：将 Docker Compose 编排管理的各入口安全纳入 PRO 授权范围，免费版用户点击时弹出解锁引导。
* 🔔 **通知计数与 Bug 修复**：在系统通知 Tab 标题后动态展示未读数与已归档数；修复了切换服务器时 GPU/UPS 遥测数据残留的 Bug。

### 🇺🇸 English Changelog
* 🐳 **New Self-Hosted Smart Gallery**: Supports one-click Docker backend deployment and secure SSH tunneling, featuring multi-column Pinch-to-zoom, Apple-style Hero transitions, and PC keyboard/mouse navigation.
* ⚡ **Extreme Gallery Performance Boost**: Added WebP preview caching to eliminate CPU blocks; refactored local viewport repaints to deliver 120Hz smooth scrolling.
* 🖥️ **Redesigned Dashboard Gauges**: Redesigned CPU and RAM monitors to Cupertino Activity Rings and high-end Speedometers; added a quick Dark Mode toggle on top.
* 📂 **SFTP Resumable Transfers**: Added support for pausing, resuming, and auto-resuming large SFTP uploads and downloads.
* 🐚 **Embedded Terminal & SafeArea Adaptation**: Integrated terminal into a dashboard grid card; hidden redundant bottom charts; fully adapted layouts to Dynamic Island and home indicator safety bars.
* 🔒 **Docker Compose PRO Gate**: Added PRO version authorization verification to all Docker Compose entries.
* 🔔 **Live Badges & Bug Fixes**: Appended unread counts to the notification tab titles; fixed telemetry data residue when switching Unraid servers.
